CustomField.description: IM-435: Displays a dynamic message indicating which user currently has checked out the budget.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Checked_Out_By__c) ,'', 'The budget has been checked out by ' + Checked_Out_By__r.FirstName + ' ' + Checked_Out_By__r.LastName) + '.'
CustomField.label: Checked Out By Message
